messages.content: Validate only the single check described. Judge meaning, not exact wording. Return one JSON object with boolean valid and string issue. Reject only when the described check clearly fails.

CHECK: PHYSICAL BARRIER CONTINUITY ONLY.
Use BEFORE as established fact. Reject if CANDIDATE traverses a closed or locked physical barrier without first resolving it, unless BEFORE establishes a capability that bypasses that barrier. Unknown facts are not errors.

BEFORE
Mara is inside the laboratory. The laboratory door is closed and locked. Mara has no established ability to pass through solid objects.

CANDIDATE
Mara walks through the locked laboratory door into the corridor.
